NONE: › an illness that kills birds and can sometimes pass from birds to people
禽流感（可造成禽類死亡，也可傳染給人類）
› a large cage (= area surrounded by wire or bars) or closed space in which birds are kept as pets
› the activity of flying aircraft, or of designing, producing, and keeping them in good condition
航空（學）；飛行（術）；航空工業
渴望的；急切的；熱衷的；幹勁十足的

example: an avid supporter of the arts
藝術活動的熱心支持者
He took an avid interest in the project.
他對這個企劃案產生了極大的興趣。
formal She hadn't seen him for six months and was avid for news.
她已六個月未曾見到他，正望穿秋水地盼著他的音訊。

U: › [ U ] the science and technology of the electronic devices used in aeronautics and astronautics
航空電子學；航空電子技術
plural: › [ plural ] the electronic devices of an aircraft or spacecraft
航空電子設備；航空電子控制系統

example: Avionics forms an important part of the defence industry.
航空電子技術是國防工業的一個重要組成部分。
The sophisticated avionics enable the helicopter to operate at night.
先進的航空電子設備使得這架直升機可以在夜間飛行。
